headline: Heard security deposit disputes over 106 Birch Court and 73 Buell Street Apt. 1; hearings closed with no ruling recorded.
summary: Tenants and landlords presented evidence in two security deposit cases at 106 Birch Court and 73 Buell Street Apt. 1. A third case, at 54B Intervale Avenue, settled before its hearing. The minutes record no votes or rulings, and the board deliberated in private.
plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, October 5, 2026, 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
https://zoom.us/j/96490499636  
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Emma Ramirez-Richer, Dylan Shelby 
Staff present: Shay Brunvand 
Meeting called to order at 06:35 PM 
1. Kyla Rathbone (tenant); Ertan Barucic (landlord) Security Deposit Case Re: 106 Birch Court. 
Present were Ertan Barucic, Attorney Timothy Fair, and Kyla Rathbone,  
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
2. Jonah Cather-Walter and Jonas Tenzer (tenants); Gardner Properties LLC c/o Neil Gardner 
(landlord) Security Deposit Case Re: 73 Buell Street Apt. 1 
Present were Ally Peeters and Jonah Cather-Walter. 
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
3. Lana Peters (tenant); MR Dupont Real Estate, LLC c/o Daniel Hogan (landlord) Security deposit 
Case Re: 54B Intervale Avenue.  
The parties reached a settlement prior to the hearing. The hearing did not take place. 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 7:48 PM 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
